The data indicates that total revenue grew from $15,785 million in FY2021 to $17,606 million in FY2022, representing an increase of approximately 11.5%. During the same period, operating income increased from $5,802 million to $6,098 million, a rise of roughly 5.1%.

This growth pattern reflects a strengthening margin profile relative to revenue expansion. In FY2021, the implied operating margin was approximately 36.8% ($5,802M / $15,785M). Actually, looking at the raw numbers again, the margin *declined* slightly in absolute percentage points despite the absolute dollar increase in operating income. The company achieved scale (higher profit dollars) but with a lower efficiency ratio on revenue in this specific comparison.
